name: linkedin-humanizer
description: Remove the AI tells human readers and LinkedIn''s AI-slop filter react to in a post or comment: 2026 vocabulary by paragraph density, reveal bridges, staccato fragments, stacked triads, performed sincerity. Tiered rewriter (forensic / strict / aesthetic / all) plus `--mode audit` pass-fail review and `--mode profile` voice profile builder. Not for beating AI detectors (no edit reliably does). Keywords: humanize, de-AI, reads like ChatGPT, AI slop, scrub AI tells, review this draft, audit before
author: sergebulaev
summary_zh: 帮助识别并改写帖子或评论中的 AI 腔调，适合发布 LinkedIn 内容前审核和调整表达风格。
